samplePages.title: Unit 1: Introduction to Data Structures & Asymptotic Analysis

sections.heading: 1.1 Time & Space Complexity Big-O Hierarchy
sections.body: Algorithm analysis measures resource growth rate relative to input size n. Master Theorem is frequently asked for 5 marks in SPPU Dec exams.
sections.formula: T(n) = a T(n/b) + f(n)  ⇒  Case 1: If f(n) = O(n^{log_b a - ε}), T(n) = Θ(n^{log_b a})
sections.pyqAlert: ★ SPPU Dec 2022 (5M): State Master Theorem & solve T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n
sections.tips: Examiner tip: Always draw the recurrence tree diagram for full step marks!

sections.heading: 1.2 Abstract Data Types (ADT) vs Data Structures
sections.body: ADT specifies WHAT operations can be performed (e.g., Stack has push, pop, peek), while Data Structure specifies HOW it is implemented in memory (Array vs Linked List representation).

samplePages.title: Unit 2: Linear Data Structures — Singly & Doubly Linked Lists

sections.heading: 2.1 Memory Representation & Node Structure
sections.body: Dynamic allocation via struct Node { int data; struct Node* next; }. Eliminates continuous memory limitation of static arrays.
sections.pyqAlert: ★ SPPU In-Sem 2023 (6M): Write C function to reverse a Singly Linked List in-place with O(1) extra space.
sections.tips: Remember to track three pointers: prev = NULL, current = head, next = NULL.

sections.heading: 2.2 Circular Linked List vs Doubly Linked List
sections.body: In Circular Doubly Linked List, head->prev = tail and tail->next = head. Crucial for operating system Round-Robin CPU scheduling queues.

samplePages.title: Unit 3: Non-Linear Structures — AVL Trees & Rotations

sections.heading: 3.1 Balance Factor (BF) & Rotations
sections.body: An AVL tree is a self-balancing BST where Balance Factor = Height(Left Subtree) - Height(Right Subtree) ∈ {-1, 0, 1}.
sections.formula: Balance Factor (BF) = h_L - h_R. If |BF| > 1, perform LL, RR, LR, or RL rotation.
sections.pyqAlert: ★ SPPU May 2023 (8M): Construct AVL tree by inserting: 14, 17, 11, 7, 53, 4, 13 with step-by-step tree diagrams.
